boundary: Bounded owner-local software or wholly synthetic evidence only; never empirical confirmation, participant evidence, professional authority, production readiness, legal or cultural ratification, Māori authority, affected-party acceptance, complete privacy or accessibility assurance, exhaustive security, independent reproduction, AGI or ASI, consciousness or personhood evidence, Theory-of-Everything proof, proof or canon, or Stage 20 authority.

rows.failed_witness: The first bounded portfolio-title projection used the Windows default CP-1252 output path and raised UnicodeEncodeError when it reached a Māori-language title.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: The corrected projection returned all twenty skill and ten runner titles without changing a repository byte or weakening the retained language boundary.
rows.recovery: Set PYTHONUTF8 and PYTHONIOENCODING to UTF-8 only for the read-only projection subprocess, then inspect the same committed portfolio by exact category.
rows.recurrence_guard: Use subprocess-scoped UTF-8 for validators and projections that can encounter Māori-language text; never rewrite valid UTF-8 to satisfy a legacy console codec.

rows.failed_witness: A read-only proposal-freeze projection guessed the keys declared_chain_before and declared_chain_after and raised KeyError because the committed schema uses different names.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: The actual x1 schema and its sixty-row distribution remained intact and were consumed by the x2 builder without any mutation to x1.
rows.recovery: Inspect the exact committed top-level keys first and read the chain values from the actual schema rather than projecting an inherited field name.
rows.recurrence_guard: Schema-sensitive probes must enumerate real keys before selecting fields and must fail closed on an absent key.

rows.failed_witness: The first combined Codex CLI, Python, and Git version wrapper completed without an attributable serialized payload, so it earned no environment-verification credit.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: The isolated probes returned codex-cli 0.150.1, Python 3.12.10, and Git 2.55.0.windows.2, each with exit code zero and no update or installation.
rows.recovery: Run the three read-only version probes as independently attributable bounded commands and retain their complete exit-code envelopes.
rows.recurrence_guard: Do not treat a zero-exit grouped wrapper with no visible evidence as a passing receipt.

rows.failed_witness: The first stale-domain scan passed a Windows wildcard as a literal rg path and rg rejected the invalid filename syntax before scanning the tool modules.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: The corrected scan completed with no inherited owner, phase, or object-domain label inside the generated sail tool modules.
rows.recovery: Use rg's explicit -g file filter against the literal scripts directory, then inspect the exact generated builder and test ranges separately.
rows.recurrence_guard: On Windows, use rg -g for wildcard filtering and reserve path arguments for literal existing paths.

rows.failed_witness: The combined remaining-skill initializer and x2-builder wrapper crossed its response window after initialization and exposed neither the builder result nor its session handle.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: No builder process remained, and complete persisted receipts proved sixty proposals, 240 rejections, fifty-four controls, twenty skills, ten runners, and three tools finished once.
rows.recovery: Do not launch a competing builder. Inspect bounded process state and the persisted build, phase-truth, skill, and runner receipts before deciding whether any dependency remains.
rows.recurrence_guard: When a wrapper may outlive its response window, print the complete command envelope or session identifier and inspect persisted state before any retry.

rows.failed_witness: The first two staged-privacy summary projections selected nonexistent convenience fields and returned null counts, including one projection after the actual key list was visible.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: The existing receipt proved 260 staged text files, six definition or synthetic-test candidates, zero confirmed payload hits, and two self-exclusions without rerunning its scan.
rows.recovery: Read only the exact schema keys scanned_text_files, candidates, confirmed_hit_count, and self_exclusions from the already-written successful privacy receipt.
rows.recurrence_guard: After enumerating a receipt's keys, project those exact names rather than inventing a normalized presentation schema.
